description: This file implements Base64 encoding and decoding functions, including standard and URL-safe variants, within the 'clearkeydrm' namespace. It provides functions to encode binary data to Base64 strings and decode Base64 strings back to binary buffers, handling padding and URL-safe character replacements.

methods.name: decodeBase64
methods.description: Decodes a Base64-encoded string into a Buffer object, handling padding and character validation.

methods.name: encode6Bit
methods.description: Encodes a 6-bit value into its corresponding Base64 character.

methods.name: encodeBase64
methods.description: Encodes binary data into a Base64 string.

methods.name: encodeBase64Url
methods.description: Encodes binary data into a URL-safe Base64 string, replacing '+' and '/' characters.
